expected.classReason: The PoC shows one signer's signature, sent twice, meeting a threshold of two. SignatureDepositQueue and SignatureRedeemQueue execute any order checkSignatures accepts at a price inside the oracle's band, so one signer, a role the listing does not exclude, can approve deposits and redemptions on its own terms against the other holders' assets: direct theft of user funds, Critical.
